text:
maria: quick question — for the feature rollouts that touch user prompts, what are our current retention windows for logs / traces / in-memory caches? Need to answer a customer GDPR question.

ashwin: short answer: logging pipeline (structured app logs) = 30d by default, traces = 90d, long-term analytics (aggregates) = 365d. cache TTLs vary: request-level caches 0-1h, LRU KV cache for model prefixes relies on eviction not hard delete.

maria: ah ok — do the app logs ever contain full prompts / PII today? customers are asking us to delete specific utterances.

ashwin: we try to redact prompts in server-side logs. current rule only redacts when request.payload.prompt is present in plain text logs, but some debug logs still print `input_text` in workers v1.2.4. We should avoid logging raw prompt text anywhere.

devops-bot: Reminder: security policy doc updated — https://redwood.internal/policies/log-retention (last updated 2025-06-12) :page_facing_up:

ashwin: action items I can take:
- add a logging-redaction rule in the pipeline to strip `prompt` and `user_text` fields
- backfill a scrubber job that removes raw prompt entries from the last 30d index
- confirm cache behavior w/ infra (KV cache persists only in-memory, but some Dedicated setups snapshot caches for debugging)

sarah: for deletion requests (GDPR right to erasure) we need the user identifier + approximate timestamp. Legal prefers a ticket with evidence; infra can attempt index-level removal but not guaranteed for caches.

tony: @ashwin can you drop the small config snippet you plan to add so I can review? want to make sure we don't accidentally drop required metadata.

ashwin: sure — planning to add something like:
```
redaction_rules:
  - field: prompt
    replace_with: "[REDACTED_PROMPT]"
  - field: user_text
    replace_with: "[REDACTED]"
log_retention_days: 30
trace_retention_days: 90
```

ashwin: note: we will not redact audit logs (security/audit) which are kept 180d and contain action metadata but should not contain raw prompt content.

maria: thanks. what's the plan for removing already-stored prompt text in logs? customer asked for a single-tenant deletion across all sources.

ashwin: plan:
1) run scrubber job for our log index (Elasticsearch) to replace prompt fields for given user_id range — best-effort for last 30d
2) for traces, remove spans that contain PII (rare) and rotate indices older than 90d
3) for Dedicated/private deployments we need a manual process; infra ops to confirm snapshots/backups.

devops-bot: Note: open infra ticket RINF-572 for Dedicated snapshot verification.

sarah: also file a GDPR erasure ticket (legal) referencing RINF-572 and include the user id + first/last seen timestamps.

tony: i'll review the PR once ashwin posts it. quick ask — can we add a unit test to ensure `prompt` fields are redacted before logs are emitted?

ashwin: yep will add unit + e2e scrubber test. posting PR shortly.

maria: perfect — thanks everyone, please @me on the PR. :white_check_mark:

tony: nice, thanks.

maria: closing loop — I'll reply to the customer with the above timeline (scrubber + legal ticket) once PR merges.
